about.title: About this portal
about.whatBody: A public archive of India's polar science: expeditions to Antarctica, the Arctic and the Southern Ocean, the research stations Maitri, Bharati, Himadri and Himansh, and the reports, datasets, publications, photos and events they produce. It is a prototype built for Smart India Hackathon 2026, problem statement 26063 from the Ministry of Earth Sciences and the National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research (NCPOR).
about.sourcesBody: Expedition and station facts come from public NCPOR and Ministry of Earth Sciences pages and from Wikipedia under CC BY-SA. Photos come from Wikimedia Commons and public-domain sources. Every record shows its source, license and credit.
about.aiBody: When staff upload a report, an AI model drafts a summary from the report's own text, and every sentence cites its source page. Photos get AI-drafted captions and descriptions. These drafts require staff approval before publication. Ask the archive generates answers from published sources when you submit a question; these answers are checked automatically, not individually reviewed by staff. Follow the source links to read the original material.
about.languagesBody: Every page is available in English and Hindi. Use the language link at the top of any page. Where a record has not been translated yet, its text is shown in English. The site aims to follow the Guidelines for Indian Government Websites (GIGW) and WCAG 2.1 AA: it works with a keyboard, images have text descriptions, and pages declare their language for screen readers.

api.title: Open data API
api.intro: Every published record in the archive is available as JSON. No key or account is needed. The API is read-only and returns published records only.

api.files: PDFs, photos and dataset files are linked by each record's url field and served directly from file storage.
api.exFilter: Arctic reports, with linked expeditions and stations filled in

api.pLocale: en, hi, or all (both languages side by side). Missing Hindi text falls back to English.
api.pWhere: Filter records. Operators include equals, not_equals, in, greater_than, less_than and like.
api.pSort: Field to sort by; put - in front for descending order.
api.pDepth: 0 returns linked records as ids; 1 or 2 fills them in.
api.pSelect: Return only the listed fields, e.g. select[title]=true.
api.license: Reuse of each record follows its license and credit fields.
